title: Small data machine learning: the trilemma of low-sample tabular regimes
abstract: arXiv:2611.30118v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small tabular datasets leave few observations for choosing a model and assessing its predictions. We examine these competing demands in controlled simulations and on six public datasets, using SmallGBM and SmallMLP as fixed-configuration case studies. Three results illustrate why the choice of evaluation matters. First, at n = 100, five-fold cross-validation overstated the gain from tuning XGBoost by 0.063 ROC-AUC on random labels, while tuning improved independent-test ROC-AUC by 0.0078 on a Gaussian mixture. Second, when 20% of binary training labels were flipped, the median within-trial ROC-AUC loss was 0.0210 for SmallGBM and 0.0778 for a fixed 200-tree XGBoost configuration. A separate regression experiment showed the sensitivity of squared-error training to heavy-tailed responses. translated_title: 小数据机器学习：低样本表格数据场景下的三难困境
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.30118v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：小型表格数据集仅留下极少的观测样本用于模型选择和预测评估。我们在受控模拟实验和六个公开数据集上考察了这些相互竞争的需求，并以 SmallGBM 和 SmallMLP 作为固定配置的案例研究。三个结果说明了评估方式的选择为何至关重要。第一，在 n=100 时，五折交叉验证在随机标签上将从调参 XGBoost 获得的收益夸大了 0.063 ROC-AUC，而调参在高斯混合数据的独立测试集上仅带来 0.0078 的 ROC-AUC 提升。第二，当 20% 的二分类训练标签被翻转时，SmallGBM 的单次试验内 ROC-AUC 损失中位数为 0.0210，而固定的 200 棵树 XGBoost 配置为 0.0778。另一项独立的回归实验表明，平方误差训练对重尾响应较为敏感。第三，在异方差回归实验中，局部加权的 SmallMLP 预测区间比普通区间多覆盖约一个百分点的测试响应。（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了小样本表格机器学习中的三难困境——模型选择、评估可靠性与鲁棒性难以兼得，并通过模拟和六个公开数据集证明评估方法的选择（如交叉验证会夸大调参收益、树模型对标签噪声更稳健）会决定性地影响小数据场景下的结论。
en_tdlr: This paper exposes the trilemma of low-sample tabular machine learning—model selection, evaluation reliability, and robustness cannot all be optimized simultaneously—showing via simulations and six public datasets that evaluation choices (e.g., cross-validation overstating tuning gains, tree models being more robust to label noise) critically shape conclusions in small-data regimes.
